title: Naturalistic measure of social norms alignment
abstract: arXiv:2605.23420v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Social norms reflect shared expectations on acceptable behavior. Measuring social norms alignment remains challenging, with existing approaches typically relying on artificial closed-form evaluations such as multiple-choice questionnaires or measuring agreement with predefined statements. In the context of this work, social norms alignment refers to measuring an agreement between solutions with respect to the social problem or dilemma. We propose a framework for measuring social norm alignment in naturalistic, free-form settings through solution matching. The framework enables us to measure alignment between any two dilemma responses e.g., LLMs to a human, LLMs to LLMs, or human to human. We introduce two metrics: stated and explicit agreement accuracy, and construct a dataset of 3k non-trivial social dilemmas in Danish. All dilemmas are assigned reference solutions derived from three panelists, who serve as culturally grounded judge

translated_title: 社会规范对齐的自然化测量方法
translated_abstract: 社会规范反映了人们对可接受行为的共同期望。测量社会规范对齐仍然具有挑战性，现有方法通常依赖人工设计的封闭式评估，例如多项选择问卷，或衡量与预先定义陈述的一致性。在本研究的语境中，社会规范对齐是指测量针对社会问题或困境的不同解决方案之间的一致性。我们提出了一个框架，通过解决方案匹配的方式，在自然、自由形式的场景中测量社会规范对齐。该框架使我们能够测量任意两个困境回答之间的对齐程度，例如大语言模型（LLM）与人类之间、LLM与LLM之间，或人与人之间。我们引入了两个指标：陈述一致性准确率和显式一致性准确率，并构建了一个包含3000个非平凡丹麦语社会困境的数据集。所有困境均配有由三名小组成员得出的参考解决方案，他们充当具有文化根基的评判者。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种通过解决方案匹配在自然、自由形式场景下测量社会规范对齐的新框架，引入两个一致性指标并构建了3000个丹麦语社会困境数据集，可用于测量LLM与人类之间或人与人之间的规范一致性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a framework for measuring social norms alignment in naturalistic, free-form settings through solution matching, introducing two agreement metrics and a dataset of 3k Danish social dilemmas to enable alignment measurement between LLMs and humans, LLMs and LLMs, or humans and humans.
